scope: Independent review of sealed 732 timing-baseline refresh and balanced-Vitest per-file receipts. Read-only source/evidence inspection; no full suite, campaign, build, source correction, or test rerun.
head: c46faf3f97508e97ab7486c172c74126c7154169

findings.finding: runVitestChild defaults its child environment to process.env. In an actual balanced worker, tests/run_vitest_balanced.test.ts launches a real nested Vitest child without an explicit environment. That child inherits the outer AWWV_VITEST_RECEIPT_* identity and appends an unplanned fixture's events to the outer lane file, outside the manifest plan and with an independently initialized sequence.
findings.impact: The diagnostic can misattribute nested control work to the outer file and corrupt the lane's sequence/unfinished-file interpretation during the real balanced suite. The retained 34-test focused run started without an outer receipt context and therefore does not exercise this path.
findings.required_correction: Remove all receipt-context variables from runVitestChild's default child environment. Keep explicit receipt environments for planner-owned balanced children and receipt-contract fixtures. Add a regression that starts with a populated parent receipt context and proves an ordinary nested child cannot append to that parent file.

findings.finding: The receipt sequence begins at zero in every custom-runner constructor. Vitest 2.1.9 uses one worker at a time when fileParallelism is false, but with the default isolated pool it dispatches ordinary files as separate single-file worker tasks and resolves a new runner for each task. Those tasks reuse the same planner lane JSONL, so each file can append sequence 1..N again.
findings.impact: Sequence is not unique or monotonic per lane in the intended full-suite topology. A consumer cannot reliably order or validate events by the advertised sequence field. All retained receipt contract runs use one fixture file per child and do not prove the multi-file lane case.
findings.required_correction: Make sequence allocation durable across runner instances that share a lane, or remove/change the field's contract. Add a real two-file same-lane Vitest regression that proves one strictly increasing sequence and exact planned file ownership.

findings.finding: onAfterRunSuite persists execution_finish before calling and awaiting super.onAfterRunSuite. The native hook performs snapshot finalization and can reject. The receipt can therefore claim pass before Vitest's own file finalization fails.
findings.impact: A completed pass receipt can be false even when the child ultimately exits nonzero. This violates the finish record's stated truth boundary.
findings.required_correction: Await native onAfterRunSuite first and append execution_finish only after it succeeds. Add a focused custom-runner regression in which native finalization rejects and the lane retains only truthful pre-finish events.

findings.finding: recorded_at_utc calls the mutable global Date constructor after test code has run. A file that leaves Vitest fake timers/system time active can write a fabricated or regressing wall-clock timestamp. No retained fixture exercises fake timers.
findings.impact: The external diagnostic timestamp may become unreasonable and can undermine chronological analysis, even though it does not enter GameState or saves.
findings.required_correction: Capture/use a real diagnostic clock outside test-controlled globals and prove recorded timestamps remain plausible and durations finite/nonnegative when a fixture activates fake timers.

nonblocking_observations: Receipt persistence uses synchronous append plus fsync; write errors are not caught in the custom runner and therefore propagate.
Create-new run directories and lane files prevent overwrite; the balanced runner cleanup is limited to generated configs and does not delete receipt telemetry or fixtures.
The receipt clock and unique run naming remain external harness diagnostics and do not enter GameState, saves, simulation ordering, or planning determinism.
Pass, fail, skip, collection error, and killed CPU-bound import start-only behavior are demonstrated at one-file scope.
Reporter passthrough --reporter=dot --silent does not disable the configured custom runner.
No production engine, gameplay, data, save, threshold, or canon file appears in the 15-file source scope.

validation.reason_no_rerun: The four findings are established by final source plus the installed Vitest 2.1.9 worker lifecycle. A correction is required before a focused rerun can answer a new question.
